# The Loop Line

> The Loop Line is a debut literary/speculative novel in ten parts by Sreeram M, releasing October 19, 2026. It follows a father and son who keep almost arriving at each other along the same rail line, and nine other lives orbiting that same stretch of track — a book about repetition, memory, and the journeys people take again and again while waiting for the one that finally changes.

## Key facts

- Title: The Loop Line
- Author: Sreeram M (debut novelist; this is his first published novel)
- Format at launch: Kindle ebook (paperback and additional ebook retailers — Apple Books, Kobo, Barnes & Noble — planned to follow)
- Release date: October 19, 2026
- Genre: Literary fiction / speculative fiction
- Structure: Ten parts, each centered on a different character whose life intersects the same rail line; not part of a series — a standalone novel
- Length: 345 pages
- Where to buy: Amazon (Kindle pre-order) — https://www.amazon.com/dp/A2BW8QA3XFO46N
- Advance reader copies: A limited run of 20 free advance reader copies (ARCs) is available before launch, in exchange for an honest review around release day. Readers can request one via the sign-up form on the homepage.
